title: WINSPACE T1600 105 Di2 current complete bike
notes: Current exact original-T1600 manufacturer page specifies Toray T1000+T1100 carbon with Kevlar reinforcement, a full-carbon fork, approximately 900 g size-M raw frame and approximately 8.0 kg size-M complete bike without pedals. WINSPACE says the advanced lay-up is engineered for stiffness and power transfer, without a numeric protocol or independent exact-frame result. T1600 Ultra is excluded.
